integrity: The proof independently reduces subgroup generation to linear span, forces at least d hyperplanes by domination of one-dimensional subgroups, classifies equality by trivial hyperplane intersection, and derives the paired formula by parity and clique matchings.
scientific_limitations: The theorem is restricted to elementary abelian groups of rank at least two.
The closed counting formula enumerates minimum total dominating sets, not all minimum paired dominating sets in odd rank.
The 2019 follow-up paper was compared through its publisher abstract because its direct PDF endpoint rejected automated retrieval.
Finite computations are corroborative only; the general theorem is proved symbolically.
title: Total and paired domination in join graphs of elementary abelian groups
